language.name: Plugin Language
language.desc: Select the language for the plugin interface.
language.llmRequired: LLM connection is required for translation.
language.warningCost: Using translation may incur LLM API costs.
language.deleteCacheTooltip: Delete the cached system language translation and reset.
language.deleteCacheConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the cached system language translation data?\nIf you select System Language again after deletion, a new translation will be performed.

apiKey.name: API Key & Model Registration
apiKey.desc: Register API keys for cloud providers or local LLM URLs.
apiKey.mobileLocalWarning: Local LLMs cannot be used on mobile devices.

ragEngine.name: One-Click RAG Engine
ragEngine.desc: Generates answers by referencing all notes in your vault in real-time and provides Smart Discovery features.
ragEngine.privacyNotice: 🔒 Document analysis runs locally. (Cloud AI chat may send note excerpts to generate answers.)
ragEngine.customGuide: 💡 Enable "Advanced Settings" (top right) to manually select an embedding engine.
ragEngine.mobileWarning: ⚠️ Mobile devices do not support one-click local embedding (RAG). Please select a cloud embedding model in Advanced Settings.
ragEngine.ragDisabledForEmbedding: ⚠️ RAG engine is disabled. Please enable the RAG engine first to select an embedding model.

customEmbedding.name: Custom Embedding
customEmbedding.desc: Select an embedding model from registered providers.
customEmbedding.guide: ※ Register an LLM connection above and run a connection test to add models.
customEmbedding.localWarn: ⚠️ Local models cannot be automatically verified as embedding models.\nIf indexing fails, please select an embedding-specific model.
customEmbedding.mobileWarn: ⚠️ Mobile devices cannot use local embedding models. Please select a cloud embedding.

defaultChatModel.name: Default Chat Model
defaultChatModel.desc: Select the default LLM model for the sidebar chat.
defaultChatModel.noConnections: Please add an LLM connection in settings and complete the connection test.

quickActionProvider.name: Quick Action Provider
quickActionProvider.desc: 🚨 Large or Reasoning models may cause severe latency. Use a fast, lightweight model (Instruct, Flash, or Mini-tier) for instant feedback.

quickActionModel.name: Quick Action Model
quickActionModel.desc: Select a dedicated model to use for Quick Actions. (Fast and lightweight models recommended)
quickActionModel.reasoningWarning: ⚠️ Warning: Reasoning Model detected! Quick Actions require speed; using this model may cause severe delays or infinite loops. A standard Instruct model is highly recommended.

taskModel.name: Task Model (Optional)
taskModel.desc: Dedicated lightweight model for background AI tasks (e.g., chat summarization). If empty, system default is used.

rerankerModel.name: Reranker Model (Optional)
rerankerModel.desc: Select a model to rerank RAG search results and improve context relevance.

mcp.title:
Agent
& MCP
mcp.desc: Connect external Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to use local tools, or enable the built-in server to allow other apps to control Lumina.

agentMode.name: Agent execution
agentMode.desc: Allow the LLM to autonomously use tools (e.g., search, file reading, file creation).
agentMode.maxStepsDesc: Maximum number of autonomous tool execution loops allowed per prompt to prevent infinite loops. (Default: 15)
agentMode.respectRagExclusionsDesc: If enabled, the agent will not be able to read or modify files in the ignored paths.

localServer.desc: Open a local server to access Obsidian features from external clients (AI agents, etc.).

token.name: Auth Token
token.desc: Token required for external clients to connect. Keep this private.

maxRead.name: Read Max Characters
maxRead.desc: Max characters returned per file read (Default: 20000)

externalServer.desc: Connect external Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to use additional tools in chat.

token.name: Auth Token (Optional)
token.desc: Enter a token if the server requires authentication.

permission.title: Tool Execution Permission

webSearch.title: Web Search

enable.name: Enable Web Search
enable.desc: Allow AI models to use the web search tool.

webSearch.privacyWarning: 🔒 Privacy Notice: When web search is enabled, parts of your prompt (search queries) may be sent to external search services (e.g., Tavily, Brave).

provider.name: Search Provider
provider.desc: Select the search provider to use.

apiKey.name: API Key
apiKey.desc: Enter the API key for the search service.

baseUrl.name: Base URL
baseUrl.desc: Enter the URL of your local search instance. (e.g., http://localhost:8080)

googleSearchEngineId.name: Search Engine ID (CX)
googleSearchEngineId.desc: Enter your Google Custom Search Engine ID (CX).

maxResults.name: Max Results
maxResults.desc: Maximum number of search results to retrieve. (Default: 5)

maxContentLength.name: Max Context Length
maxContentLength.desc: Maximum total characters of search results to inject into the LLM context. (Default: 3000)

chat.title:
Chat
& Prompt

history.name: Auto-save Chat History
history.savePathDesc: Automatically save chat history to a specified path. (Default: chatHistory)
history.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this chat history?
history.title: Chat History

sendMode.name: Send Message Mode
sendMode.desc: Choose how to send messages in chat. (Default: Send on Enter)

quickActions.name: User Custom Quick Actions (Commands)
quickActions.desc: Register custom prompts as Obsidian commands to execute directly on selected text.

translate.name: Translate to English
translate.prompt: Translate the following text into natural English:

explain.name: Explain
explain.prompt: Explain the following text in detail:

inlineTrigger.name: Inline Command Trigger
inlineTrigger.desc: Keyword to invoke the quick action autocomplete popup in the editor. (Default: /ai)

enableAutocomplete.name: Enable Inline Autocomplete (Ghost Text)
enableAutocomplete.desc: When you pause typing, Task LLM will predict the next sentence and show it as ghost text (Press Tab to accept).

memoryLimit.name: Conversation Memory Limit
memoryLimit.desc: How much conversation history to retain (by turns or tokens).
memoryLimit.turnsDesc: Turns to remember (1 turn = user message + AI response) (Default: 10)

modelParams.name: Model Parameters
modelParams.desc: Adjust response creativity and output length.
modelParams.tempDesc: Closer to 0 = precise, closer to 2 = creative (Default: 0.7)
modelParams.maxOutputDesc: Limits the maximum number of tokens generated per response. (Default: 4000)
modelParams.responseLangDesc: Force AI responses to a specific language. "Auto" responds in the language of the user's query.

chat.emptyResponseFallback: ⚠️ The model returned an empty response. (This may be due to an unsupported language/format, prompt filtering, or exceeding the context limit.)

rag.toggleTooltip: When enabled, the AI will read and reference notes in your vault to answer.
rag.title:
RAG
& Context
rag.embeddingWarning: RAG embedding model can be configured in the Connections & Models tab.
rag.disabledWarning: ⚪ RAG is disabled. Please enable RAG engine in the Connections & Models tab.

dataScope.name: Default Data Scope
dataScope.desc: Choose which notes to include in RAG search. (Default: Entire Vault)

autoIncludeActive.name: Auto-include Active Note
autoIncludeActive.desc: Automatically include the currently active note as context in chat.

includePaths.name: Include Paths
includePaths.desc: Comma-separated. Leave empty to include the entire vault.

ignorePaths.name: Ignore Paths
ignorePaths.desc: Comma-separated. Takes precedence over included paths. (Default: templates, chatHistory, etc.)

chunking.name: Chunking
chunking.desc: Configure chunk size and overlap for document splitting.
chunking.parentSizeDesc: Base unit for document splitting (1000~3000 chars recommended) (Default: 2000)
chunking.parentOverlapDesc: Number of overlapping characters between parent chunks (Default: 200)
chunking.childSizeDesc: Child chunk size used for vector search (100~300 chars recommended) (Default: 200)
chunking.childOverlapDesc: Number of overlapping characters between child chunks (Default: 40)

topK.name: Top-K Retrieval
topK.desc: Number of top-ranked documents to pass to the LLM. (Default: 5)

syncMode.name: Indexing Sync
syncMode.desc: How the index updates when notes change. (Default: Watch)

minSimilarity.name: Min Similarity
minSimilarity.desc: Exclude results below this relevance score (0~1) (Default: 0.0)

maxFileSize.name: Max File Size (MB)
maxFileSize.desc: Exclude files larger than this size from indexing. 0 = no limit. Default: 50 MB

reindex.name: Full Re-index
reindex.desc: Re-index all vault files from scratch.

status.name: Indexing Status
status.desc: Shows current index size and file count.

init.loadingModelDesc: Downloading and loading the local model for the first time may take a few minutes.
init.readyManual: ✅ Lumina: RAG engine ready (Manual indexing mode)

reset.name: Reset Index
reset.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset the index? This action cannot be undone.

contextMenu.name: Context Menu Integration
contextMenu.desc: Add Lumina to the editor right-click menu.

ribbonIcon.name: Show Ribbon Icon
ribbonIcon.desc: Display plugin icon in the left sidebar.

frontmatter.name: Auto-generate Frontmatter
frontmatter.desc: Automatically add frontmatter when creating new notes.

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.desc: View internal logs such as LLM requests and responses.

factoryReset.name: Data Initialization & Plugin Reset
factoryReset.desc: Reset all settings and data to defaults. (Chat history is preserved)
factoryReset.confirmMsg: Are you sure you want to reset all settings? Registered API keys, options, RAG index, downloaded local models, and system language translation cache will be deleted. (Chat history will be preserved)

donate.name: Donate & Support
donate.desc: If you find Lumina useful, please consider supporting its development!

read_active_note.desc: Reads the content of the currently active (open) note in Obsidian.

read_note.desc: Reads a specific note in the vault.
read_note.argPath: The path of the file to read (e.g. folder/note.md)

create_note.desc: Creates a new note. If the file already exists, returns an error without overwriting.
create_note.argPath: The path of the file to create (e.g. folder/new_note.md)
create_note.argContent: The initial content of the note
create_note.tooLong: The content to create exceeds the limit ({{limit}} characters).
create_note.alreadyExists: File already exists. Overwriting is not allowed: {{path}}

search_notes.desc: Searches for a specific text in all Markdown files in the vault.

append_to_note.desc: Appends content to the end of an existing note. There is a maximum file length limit (100,000 characters) to prevent infinite loops.
append_to_note.argPath: The path of the file to append content to
append_to_note.tooLong: The maximum length that can be appended at once is {{limit}} characters.
append_to_note.maxLengthExceeded: Cannot append further as the file has exceeded the maximum length (100,000 characters) to prevent infinite loops.

read_daily_note.notFound: Today's daily note does not exist: {{path}}

append_to_daily_note.desc: Appends content to today's daily note. Creates the note if it doesn't exist.
append_to_daily_note.tooLong: The maximum length that can be appended at once is {{limit}} characters.
append_to_daily_note.maxLengthExceeded: Cannot append further as the file has exceeded the maximum length (100,000 characters).
append_to_daily_note.successCreate: Daily note created and content appended: {{path}}

list_notes.desc: Lists all Markdown notes in the vault. You can optionally specify a folder path to list notes within that folder.
list_notes.argPath: The folder path to list notes from (e.g. folder/subfolder). If not provided, lists all notes in the vault.

rag_search.desc: Semantically searches notes in the vault using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Finds document chunks most similar to the query using hybrid vector search + BM25, not simple keyword matching. Only works when RAG indexing is complete.
rag_search.argQuery: The query string to perform semantic search on
rag_search.argTopK: The maximum number of results to return (Default: 5)
rag_search.notReady: RAG index is not ready. Please enable RAG in settings and complete indexing first.
rag_search.noResults: No RAG search results found. Try changing your query or lowering the min_similarity value.
rag_search.summary:
RAG Search Results ({{count}} chunks found, similarity >= {{minSim}}):

{{context}}

common.truncated: \n\n... (Content truncated due to length limit of {{limit}} characters)
common.pathExcluded: Access to this path is restricted by RAG exclusion/inclusion settings: {{path}}

generate_moc.desc: Generate a Map of Content (MOC) note that collects and links related notes from a folder, by tag, or from an explicit file list.
generate_moc.argTitle: Title of the MOC note (used as the H1 heading)
generate_moc.argOutputPath: Vault-relative path for the MOC file (e.g. "Project MOC" or "Maps/Project MOC"). .md is appended automatically.
generate_moc.argFolder: Collect notes from this folder path (optional)
generate_moc.argTags: Collect notes that have ALL of these tags (optional)
generate_moc.argFiles: Explicit list of note paths to include (optional)
generate_moc.argOverwrite: Overwrite if the file already exists (default: false)
generate_moc.emptyWarning: No notes were found matching the given scope. This MOC is currently empty.
generate_moc.noScope: At least one of folder, tags, or files must be provided.

graph.title: Lumina RAG Graph
graph.noNodes: No nodes available in current view.

canvas.noticeTruncated: Node count exceeded the maximum ({{max}}). Some nodes were excluded.
canvas.noticeNoFiles: No markdown files found in this folder.
canvas.noticeError: An error occurred while generating the canvas.

depth.name: Traversal Depth
depth.desc: How many levels of wiki-links to follow. (1 = direct links only; higher values can dramatically increase node count) (Default: 1)

layout.name: Layout
layout.desc: Choose how nodes are arranged. (Default: Radial)

bidirectional.name: Bidirectional Links
bidirectional.desc: Include both outgoing links and backlinks. (Default: Enabled)

includeAttachments.name: Include Attachments
includeAttachments.desc: Also visualize images, PDFs, and other attachments linked from notes. (Default: Disabled)

maxNodes.name: Max Nodes
maxNodes.desc: Nodes exceeding this count will be excluded from the canvas. (Default: 200)

folderDepth.name: Folder Traversal Depth
folderDepth.desc: When right-clicking a folder, how many subfolder levels to include. (0 = direct children only) (Default: 0)

outputPath.name: Canvas Output Path
outputPath.desc: The folder where generated canvas files will be saved. (Default: canvasVisualize)

showFolderGroups.name: Show Folder Groups
showFolderGroups.desc: In folder mode, group nodes by their parent folder on the canvas. (Default: Disabled)
